scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from backward equations, a martingale maximal bound, exact symbolic integration, independent boundary-value numerical tests, and independent finite Monte Carlo verification. Historical originality conditional on inspected literature.
scientific_limitations: Strictly unequal positive speeds, independently uniformly distributed initial positions and velocities, and a common reversal rate.
Only local noise-response sign, quadratic threshold, and existence of positive minimizer above threshold; no classification of global minimizers.
Uninspected broad multi-speed first-passage theorems could subsume part of the result.
title: A sharp speed-ratio threshold for beneficial tumbling in two-particle ring encounters
